reviews.text: Not recognizing squamous cell carcinoma in my cat's mouth and treating it with a month and a half of antibiotics and cortisone, and not even having the humility to say, "I can't handle it, take him to a veterinary oncologist," but rather, "Well, I can't take half his mouth off," and not even being clear in explaining the disease, but with half-sentences, shows the lack of professionalism of this facility. Examine yourselves every now and then and be humble!! I believe that being a doctor should be a vocation, and you need to be present during visits, both mentally and especially emotionally, and be clear!! If I could, I would have given you zero stars! My Blanco is no longer with us, but I could have helped him live a less painful life if the "vet" had had the humility to stop and tell me, "I can't handle it, take him to a specialist; that's how you love animals!"

I had experience at this clinic about a year ago, and I have to say I can't give it less than 5 stars because they literally saved my Ettore, who came in on the brink of death and came out stronger than ever.
My dog ​​came in at 2:00 in the morning, and I was convinced I'd never see him again, but despite that, with the necessary reassurances, after 15 days there, they gave him back to me completely healed. They were professional and empathetic, and my dog ​​loved them! Thank you!
terrible and expensive...cats and dogs die

Abandon all hope, ye who enter here. I say this in verse because if I were to say it in my own words they would only be bad words.....my cat died the day after being discharged....so draw your own conclusions.....I warned you.

Lack of professionalism and competence.
Avoid her, there are better clinics.

I wasn't familiar with this clinic. My dog, Lady, was rushed there. I was in a panic. In addition to taking care of her immediately, they also took care of me, providing me with support and reassurance. It's a shame there are only five stars because I would have given 1,000 more.
There are no words to describe this clinic and its staff. They are competent and talented people with an extraordinary humanity. Thank you for everything you've done for my lady and for everything you'll continue to do.

They saved my Linda, rushed there for a fall, taken care of immediately, everyone was very good, Dr. Amaranta Arcigli was exceptional, she always dedicated time and clarifications to us, she is a professional and a woman with a heart, all the staff were very kind, they pampered Linda as if she were their own, I truly thank everyone from the bottom of my heart, for me it was a small miracle to have Linda with me at home safe and sound after 9 days of hospitalization, thank you so much
I found out about this clinic because of my cat Hermes who had a urethrostomy. I was very satisfied with everything. The medical staff were super efficient.
Sorry to have to write that not all doctors are up to par, secretaries and nurses are very kind, but I will never take anyone else to them again, a dramatic experience.

I brought in a kitten, about 30 days old, who this morning, at her 4:00 a.m. feeding, exhibited alarming behavior: she was biting her hind legs and rolling around. She repeated this behavior at her 8:00 a.m. feeding. I took her to the San Francesco clinic (where "PAYMENT BY POST ONLY" is clearly marked at the entrance and on the cash register). As soon as I entered, I showed the video to the receptionist and was told they would see her immediately. After about an hour, they examined the kitten (who at that point repeated the behavior). They suspected encephalitis, administered Valium, and recommended immediate hospitalization. While I was in the waiting room, I noticed several people without pets, then realized they all had pets hospitalized and were waiting to visit them. I didn't like anything, from the superficial examination performed by a woman who doesn't speak Italian and who had difficulty making me understand, to the diagnosis of suspected encephalitis made by the only doctor who didn't even see the kitten and immediately recommended hospitalization (though in the meantime, they had time to whisper to each other). Alarmed and disgusted by such cynical and superficial treatment, I asked to take the kitten away. They asked me to sign a form stating that, against their advice, I was determined not to have her admitted, and I paid €52.90.
Meanwhile, my partner gave me the address of the Etiopia veterinary clinic, where the first DOCTOR immediately called a NEUROLOGIST. After a long and thorough examination, in consultation with other doctors, and after running blood tests, they ruled out encephalitis and diagnosed possible orthofacial pain syndrome (FOPS) due to the emergence of teething. A few kilometers away, an abyss of professionalism. The star is only to publish the ad, for us it would be -5.

Dr. Buti has been treating my dogs for many years, ever since he worked at the clinic in Tiburtina. When he moved, we decided to continue to trust him because throughout this time, he has always demonstrated great professionalism, competence, and availability. He is a veterinarian we have complete trust in. I would also like to extend a special thank you to Dr. Sementilli. During the most difficult moment, when we had to make the painful decision to accompany our elderly dog ​​in his final farewell, he was there for us with a humanity, sensitivity, and respect that I will never forget. In those moments, the human side counts as much as the professional, and I will always be grateful to him.

Unfortunately, however, I must also report a negative experience with Dr. Felici, who repeatedly suggested that our second dog was being mistreated. Not to mention that the dog is blind and, despite this, loves to play with a ball/pine cone, which often results in him bumping into walls, posts, doors, etc. Perhaps next time, before accusing people who have always treated animals like family, it would be wise to evaluate the full picture.
Overall, however, I continue to have great faith in the clinic thanks to Dr. Buti's professionalism and Dr. Sementilli's extraordinary humanity.
Dirty clinic, you can see they don't clean, staff without empathy, anesthesia without making sure the dog could actually do it, I don't know what to say.

INCOMPETENT, We brought them a cat that was vomiting and hadn't eaten for days, they did an X-ray and didn't notice that he had an intestinal blockage, now my cat is hospitalized with 3 days delay, furthermore they gave him an anti-vomiting drug, maybe if he continued to vomit he could have freed himself from the obstruction
Doctor Manuel Felici number 1

I would like to thank Dr. Felici, the other veterinarians, nurses, and interns who cared for my Paso.
During a particularly difficult time, I found great professionalism, availability, and attention. Paso was cared for with care and respect, and I always received clear explanations and support from all the staff.
A special thank you goes to everyone who, in addition to their professional expertise, showed sensitivity and affection, making Paso feel cared for and loved.
Thank you to all the staff for their commitment and dedication every day. During the most difficult days, it was good to see how much everyone loved him and stopped to give him a cuddle.

I had dealings with Dr. Bianca Bertoni, a cardiologist I met at the San Francesco Clinic in Rome, where I often took my dogs for check-ups. She had an echocardiogram and a therapy. I called her for an explanation on the cell phone number written on my chart and told her that I had also consulted my vet to understand the protocol. She answered me with a changed voice and that she was annoyed because I had asked my vet's opinion. I find this not the way to treat a client. She is unprofessional and very exhausted. I advise you to change your profession. I don't agree with her and I wouldn't recommend her to anyone.

A special thanks to this specialized clinic with highly competent veterinarians. I sincerely thank Dr. Manuel Felici, who has lovingly cared for my dogs for many years. He's a special doctor who treats, operates on, and pampers animals as if they were his own. I also extend thanks to veterinarian Dr. Lorenzo Caprini, whom I didn't know, and who performed excellent surgery on my Chihuahua yesterday. Congratulations to the entire staff! Highly recommended!!! Cristina
Thank you Doctor Brigjilda!!

I'm writing to leave a very positive review of Dr. Brigjilda. She displays great humanity and sensitivity, qualities that are rare in people these days! Thank you so much for the assistance and helpfulness you provided.
I had a great experience. They cured my cat who was admitted to their clinic, and the price for the stay and treatment was very reasonable! Thank you!

After attending the auction on Via Dante Bargellini, where the doctor was incredibly kind and empathetic, given the medical condition of my beloved dog, Aisha told me I needed to go to this facility (where I'd been many years ago and found excellent staff) for some quick tests. It was December 1, 2025, 9:00 PM. At 9:26 PM, the results of the tests arrived. The doctor, cold, annoyed (perhaps because of the time, who knows), and disinterested, told me that the clinical condition was critical, so the solution was: "15 days in the clinic or euthanasia." I asked for an explanation for these two very different choices and asked the price for each single day, also telling him that I'm a simple part-time sales assistant and needed more explanation to make this decision. "Why 15 days in the clinic? Is it salvageable?" He didn't seem to be cold, and he also replied, annoyed, simply that "it's like that." Instinct told me to take my beloved 15-year-old dog home because I couldn't leave her in the hands of that man, who wasn't even interested in his work, let alone my dog. End of story: my dog ​​died at his home after about two hours. I returned the next day to the auction on Via Sante Bargellini, where the same doctor had also called the clinic the night before, outside of her working hours, to inquire about my dog. I was there, and she was incredibly empathetic and reassured me that he wouldn't make it anyway. Unfortunately, I don't know the name of this doctor, but I will always remember her in that moment of great pain. I'm writing a negative review of that man today, months later, because the pain was too great. But I think it's right to do so, because this man shouldn't work with people or animals. He only cares about the financial side of things; he's willing to keep an animal alive just for the money and then let it die anyway. Zero trust in this clinic for the people who are there, including the girl who was on shift at the reception, she also had zero desire to work. Shame!
Everyone is exceptional, especially Dr. Marie, she's special♥️
Excellent service

After a particularly stressful week, I have the calm and clarity to write a review of the Clinic. I had already been assisted by the Clinic staff on two other occasions, so last Sunday my beloved cat Musetta began to struggle with breathing. When we arrived at the clinic, I witnessed a movie scene with my own eyes: Dr. Buti interrupted an examination, and Ilaria and all the nurses (whose names I don't know) rushed to assist her. In the emergency, she was stabilized and admitted to the hospital, despite Musetta's rather serious condition. I can't thank all the staff for their professionalism, kindness, presence, and care we received. Musetta has returned home, and we thank all of you for your wonderful work. A special thanks goes to Ludovica, always kind and helpful. Thank you.

A few nights ago, I brought in a cat with a suspected bladder blockage. Dr. Tesho was extremely knowledgeable in handling the situation and attentive in answering all our questions. In a moment of intense anxiety and apprehension, I found the environment I was hoping for.
Thank you again.

I recently dealt with Clinica San Francesco, and I have to say my feedback is overwhelmingly negative.
Aside from the chaos in the admissions area, the staff is in complete chaos. Young students and veterinarians are milling around without clear direction or distinctions between roles. I had the feeling that one doesn't know what the other is doing. No one has complete control over the patient's condition. Tests are performed, and the results are unclear. The medical records aren't read before speaking with the pet's owner. There's a persistent odor of dirt, and I haven't seen my hygiene and sanitation procedures before caring for the animal. In conclusion, if the animal has significant issues, I'm absolutely not up to the task.

His name is San Francesco, but it has nothing to do with the patron saint of animals, who loved them deeply.
The staff isn't very empathetic, professional, or communicative. There's little continuity in treatments, perhaps due to poor internal collaboration. Diagnoses are sketchy and don't address the actual problem. Company policy is a bit too commercial for tests and medications.
They're very careless when providing test results and communicating with pet owners.
If you're faced with a complex medical condition, they should consult with professionals or refer you to another facility as soon as possible.
I do not recommend this clinic.
Terrible veterinary service 😡 …

My dog ​​was hospitalized for three days, but unfortunately she is no longer with us. The veterinary staff is not passing care properly, and is inattentive and unprofessional. The information is fragmented and has not always been consistent. Ethically, it would have been appropriate to explain the patient's critical condition and to be humble in stating that we were unable to properly care for the little girl. The diagnosis was sketchy and incomplete upon her discharge. Furthermore, very seriously, she was not rehydrated/nourished and given appropriate insulin administration.

She was discharged against medical advice with metabolic ketoacidosis due to diabetes, but the PRIMARY condition was acute pancreatitis with complications from metabolic ketoacidosis due to diabetes. This was underestimated and not seen in time and was noted on the discharge form. The diagnosis was correctly made by the veterinarian, who then followed her up.
An abdominal ultrasound was performed, revealing colitis and underestimating the liver condition. The veterinarian on duty told me that the diagnosis was mainly colitis and that the rest was not serious, when in fact the diagnosis already stated that there were problems related to the enlarged liver, but this was omitted.
It's a clinic, and they don't even know how to make a correct and adequate diagnosis.
Furthermore, I was given EGA reports dated before the little girl's admission, which stated that the dates were November 2025 instead of January 2026. I paid for leishmaniasis tests, but I wasn't given the report.
Zoe was subsequently treated by a good veterinarian and passed away peacefully and, above all, appropriately cared for.
They should continue to teach nursing school, but at least in an ethical and professional manner, because what can you teach future veterinary surgeons if a medical director then shrugs, turns around, and walks away without even saying goodbye?
I strongly advise you to go elsewhere with your four-legged friends.

TERRIBLE RATING - THIS can be compared to HUMAN MALPRACTICE, only it's VETERINARIAN, but the point is the same.

An extremely positive experience. He was examined, given an ultrasound, and given thorough explanations. Once we were discharged, the doctor wanted us to call him to let him know how our dog was doing. People like that are rare.
I TOTALLY DISCOURAGE!!!!

This clinic truly deserves 5 stars, starting with the welcoming Ludovica Bertoldo, who was empathetic, kind, professional, and reassuring. I brought my little Chihuahua,
Ella, in a truly critical condition. I was terrified of losing her. Every doctor and nurse took care of my little girl day after day with great affection. Dr. Brigijlda Nldoka, who with her sweetness tried to explain everything that was happening to me, but without taking anything away from the others, my greatest thanks, with all my esteem, go to Dr. Manuel Felici, for his professional and human qualities, for the love he has for animals, and thanks to him, my little Ella was able to return to my arms. ♥️ Thank you all.

Lack of seriousness, forgetfulness in giving the entire complete report. I have to call 3 times to ask for an X-ray report in two projections. They always ask me for the email address 3 times and then not even "sorry, we forgot". It could be an oversight. I am told that I am WASTING TIME. I paid €289 for the tests and an X-ray without a response. I wouldn't give even half a star.

Honest and very polite people.
Dr. Luca and his colleague were very professional, as was the secretary, who welcomed us warmly.
I absolutely recommend this clinic.

Super positive experience
From the initial reception to the initial visit, they were exceptional, kind, professional, and very competent.
A special thanks to Dr. Felici, who treated my two cats so well.

Grateful ❣️

Terrible experience, a place to avoid. Dr. Albano operated on my dog's broken leg, making practically every mistake, and most importantly, he never showed up after the botched operation: he never took a personal interest in the situation. He made us waste time that would have been needed to recover the leg, and months later, we had to redo everything at another facility. The dog suffered, he will probably remain lame, and we spent a lot of money... AVOID GOING THERE.

I went to the clinic at the end of May for a suspected foxtail in my 10-kg dog's nose. They invited me to give her an anti-inflammatory (available at their in-house pharmacy) and meet again in a week. The dog sneezed less, but as soon as the anti-inflammatory was finished, she started sneezing again. Once I returned to the clinic, they told me that after several days, an endoscopy was necessary. For the modest sum of €580, the endoscopist showed me the foxtail just removed: it was smooth and clean... after 10 days!! Unfortunately, a few days later, she had another foxtail. When I returned to the clinic, they again talked to me about an endoscopy. When I mentioned that she had had it the day before, the doctor, in an altered and annoyed tone, turned his back on me, saying that if he couldn't find it with the simple turbinate instrument, it was my fault for the dog having to undergo another anesthesia. Since I know that a professional

Unfortunately, my experience at this clinic was terrible. I took my dog, who had been losing her appetite for over 10 days, for a liver ultrasound.
Diagnosed with an enlarged liver.
A blood test was performed, with normal parameters. They tell me the dog is doing quite well.
Unconvinced by the diagnosis, the next day I took her to another vet, who realized the tests had been done on her as if she were a cat.
Repeated tests and an ultrasound revealed liver lymphoma.
My little girl is no longer with us, but please stay away.

My cat, suffering from kidney failure, was hospitalized urgently. Over €600 was spent on tests alone, without a clear diagnosis. Every time we asked for clarification, we were treated condescendingly, as if they were doing us a favor by answering.

We were never able to speak to the same veterinarian twice, and there was no continuity or coordination in the treatment process. For every small step, even just a prescription, we were referred to an affiliated practice, incurring additional costs.

We were prescribed the wrong treatment and told the cat would only have a few weeks/months to live.

Luckily, we sought a second opinion at another facility, where we were treated with professionalism and care. With a new, completely different treatment, and at a tenth of the cost, the cat began to improve significantly.

My sincere advice: if you can, travel a few miles further and look elsewhere.

I highly recommend the San Francesco Veterinary Clinic, where we were greeted promptly and professionally. We were especially cared for by two women, Ilaria and Mariavittoria, who were truly kind and who conveyed their passion for their work.
They resolved the situation immediately, friendly and kind.
Excellent veterinary clinic
Honest prices and super professional staff... We had a great time.

Everything I could have hoped for and asked for my friends, Artù and Merlino, I found in this clinic, where I've always been treated in emergency situations and where I've found so much expertise, patience, humanity, helpfulness, and cleanliness.

My friends, in the almost five and seven years they've been with me, had always been very well, and then they all decided to get sick together: one with struvite, resulting in urinary blockage and catheterization twice in the space of a month, intestinal obstruction, and a cold (Merlino conquered everything), and the other with cystitis and a cold (Artù didn't want to be outdone).

The doctors, as well as the veterinary technicians, had infinite patience with both them and with me, their exhausted biped!

They welcomed us at all hours of the night and day (I was always in tears) with warmth, humanity, sincerity, honesty, and competence.
Perhaps, and I say perhaps only for good luck, we've almost overcome all the troubles of this month, but I want to thank, from the bottom of my heart, the entire staff at the San Francesco Clinic, starting with the Medical Director, Dr. Luca Buti, for his professionalism in selecting his entire staff, and all the administrative staff, especially Ludovica, because even financially, given the numerous hospitalizations and tests, they always tried to accommodate me even more, even though the clinic's costs are absolutely in line, if not lower, than many other places, given the high quality of the service.

Thanks to all the veterinary technicians, Diana, Ilaria, and Alessio, who always tried to bring a smile to my face in moments of tiredness and worry, and a special thanks also to Merlino and Artù, who, refusing food, were patiently spoon-fed, cuddled, and cared for in the best possible way.

Last but not least, the veterinarians who treated them and who also "treated" me during this month of constant emergencies and so much stress: Dr. Michele Sementilli, the gentle giant who always has a word of consolation; Dr. Francesca Grieco, whose care, kindness, and dedication to what she does are exemplary; and finally, Dr. Viktor Tesho, whose professionalism, empathy, expertise, and calmness always reassured me that my friends were in good hands.

I'm sorry I can't remember any more names, but I certainly remember your eyes, your smiles, and your welcome during a truly stressful and chaotic time in my life. So, thank you all and send you a hug.
I hope to visit you again soon, but without any emergencies this time!

I recommend this facility to everyone for its professionalism, hygiene, expertise, humanity, and affordability.

I feel I absolutely must thank this clinic and all its staff for their patience and dedication in treating a very annoying problem for my Aussie. An ear hematoma, an extremely long and painful treatment and healing process, which, thanks to the skill and great professionalism of Dr. Veronica Sheremet, is finally moving in the right direction. Thank you so much from the bottom of my heart for your kindness, attention, and empathy.
You are all wonderful 😌🙏🏻

VERY WELL DONE
I called because I was worried my dog ​​had hurt his head, and they helped me over the phone and reassured me.
So from my experience, I can only say that they are very kind, helpful, and very professional.

Hello, unfortunately I have to give one star, not for the clinic itself, but for the doctor—yes, let's call him a veterinarian—who, on Wednesday, March 26, 2025, at around 10:00 PM, examined my beloved cat for no more than 5 minutes. I should start by saying that, unfortunately, he passed away the next day, and I should also point out that he was 18 years old and had a malignant polyp in his bladder. However, if you're a 24-hour veterinary clinic and have an emergency room, at least an ultrasound or something should be done. He simply emptied his bladder by pressing it, obviously only drawing blood. My question was, what can we give him or do? He's in danger. I should also point out that I had an appointment with my vet the next day. He was very calm, calm down, there's no danger, he'll take him to his vet tomorrow. The moral of the story is that the next morning he died after a hellish night. Kudos to his sensitivity and professionalism; one star is even too many.

I write this review with a heart full of gratitude and deep appreciation for the entire team at the San Francesco Veterinary Clinic. In a moment of immense sadness and pain, having to say goodbye to my beloved dog, I found in this clinic not only professionalism, but above all a humanity and warmth that I will never forget.
I would like to express my sincerest and profound gratitude to Dr. Sementilli, who, with his immense sensitivity and understanding, accompanied me in that difficult final embrace. His empathy and the delicate way in which he handled that painful moment were of inestimable comfort to me. Thank you from the bottom of my heart, Dr. Sementilli, for your humanity.
A special thanks also goes to Dr. Buti, who over the years has always proven to be an exceptional professional, always courteous, available, and ready to help me in any situation regarding my little dog's health. His expertise and dedication have been invaluable.
A round of applause and heartfelt thanks go to Ludovica from the reception desk. Her kindness, infinite patience, warmth, empathy, and unwavering availability have been a true support. In every call and visit, Ludovica has always greeted me with a smile and a kind word, demonstrating extraordinary sensitivity. Thank you so much, Ludovica, for your humanity and professionalism.
I would also like to mention and sincerely thank Valentina Nocella, Dr. Albano's secretary, Gabriella Manni, Alessio Valenti, Francesca Grieco, Manuel Felici, Victor Tesho, Veronika Sheremet, all the nurses, interns, and all the clinic staff. Each of you, with your professionalism and warmth, helped me feel welcomed and supported at such a delicate time. Your unspeakable patience and dedication to the well-being of the animals and the support of their owners were exemplary.
In a moment of profound despair, I clearly felt the human warmth of each of you. I never felt alone, but surrounded by people who understood my pain and did everything they could to ease it.
The San Francesco Veterinary Clinic is not just a place of care for our four-legged friends, but a place where humanity and professionalism blend together in an extraordinary way.
Thank you from the bottom of my heart to all of you for making such a painful time less difficult. Your dedication and humanity are a beacon in a dark time.
With immense gratitude,
Massimo Moscatelli

A very knowledgeable and warm team, who handled a delicate situation for my dog ​​with care and professionalism to perfection. He had a foxtail in his nose, but everything was resolved quickly. Thank you so much.

A special thanks goes to Dr. Michele Simintilli, who, with great sensitivity and professionalism, admitted my Toy Poodle a month ago, who arrived in serious condition due to severe gastritis. The staff was friendly and helpful, but I reiterate the expertise of Dr. Simintilli and Dr. Buti. Thank you.

Everyone was wonderful. From the doctors to the technicians to the administrative staff. The empathy and care for our furry friend was incredible. I can't say enough about this veterinary clinic; I've been coming to them for years.

We sincerely thank all the clinic staff, especially Dr. Felici, Dr. Caprini, and veterinary technician Carbone, for their excellent work, their canine humanity, and the extreme kindness and sensitivity in treating our case. "Era" is doing well, and we are happy 😀🥰 …

I wanted to thank you for your kindness, hospitality, and helpfulness.
Thanks to Dr. Manuel Felici and his assistant for the care and dedication with which they examined my three kittens, Mirtilla, Malesia, and Merlino, making them feel at ease, and for their willingness to answer my questions.

I would like to thank all the medical and administrative staff at the San Francesco Veterinary Clinic on Via Gennargentu, Rome, for providing excellent care and
with great empathy during the hospital stay of two of my cats, Pelosone and Tigrotto.
A special thanks goes to Dr. Sementilli, who, with his tender sweetness, supported me with great empathy and patience as I accompanied my beloved Pelosone on his final journey.
Heartfelt thanks to everyone.

Once again, all the clinic staff were efficient and professional in treating my Maltese, who had also been hospitalized at the clinic in the past. I thank everyone, you will always be our point of reference.
I went to the S. Francesco Clinic during these holidays because my dog's injury happened at night, and since it's close to my house, I thought it would be okay... …

I discovered the San Francesco Clinic thanks to some friends who introduced me to Dr. Maurizio Albano, an extremely competent and animal-loving person. Dr. Maurizio Albano, along with his highly professional and competent staff, has healed …

I've been coming to the clinic for over six years, for a variety of needs, from routine to emergency. The facility is generally well-organized, offers a variety of services at very reasonable prices, and is available 24/7, which is no small …

I wanted to thank your entire clinic for the way you do your work, done with passion and not for financial gain.
Yesterday I had the opportunity to see you tired, exhausted, but not rude, nor less than ready for those who arrived and needed your help. So thank you.

I find myself here writing after almost a year. I waited for the anger inside me to pass but nothing does and now I find myself in my bed clutching a pillow with the photo of my beloved Skizzo who, through the fault of Doctor Sementilli if …

I've always turned to this clinic for emergencies, because my cats have always had problems at times or on days when the regular vet wasn't available. They've always resolved the various issues promptly, professionally and courteously, at …
Spooky place...cold staff...without a shred of humanity...
Super-competent and always available, the veterinarians at the San Francesco Clinic finally solved a serious problem with our elderly wolf, and she's now safe! Dr. Sementilli, thank you so much!!!

Everyone is fantastic, very kind, and above all, knowledgeable. The doctor in the emergency room, Veronica, I think, was very good at immediately understanding my dog's problem. He was hospitalized for three days. During those three days, …

Terrible place. Superficial, sloppy, and unprepared vets. I was paying €70 a day for my cat's hospital stay, and they fed him from the plant saucer. I noticed that my cat suddenly looked down and wasn't eating. I first mentioned this to the …

I took my Susy for a consultation 6 months ago with a worrying cough... I've always had dogs. I've never found such a rude and unwelcoming vet. Fortunately, I don't remember the name but I was treated in an unspeakable manner. At least he had the good sense not to charge me... also because he didn't do or say anything relevant.

Well, what can I say? They're angels who came down to earth to save our four-legged friends! Courteous, friendly, and above all humble! I've never met people like them; they even managed to move me with the way they helped me with small …
All the stars go to Dr. Felici. Thank you for your professionalism, availability, and expertise.

I was impressed by the professionalism and kindness of the entire staff. My dog ​​was examined very carefully, and everything was explained in detail. I also really appreciated the welcoming and well-equipped environment of the clinic.

I'm writing after more than a year because I was hoping for at least some of my anger to subside.... A ridiculous place full of indifferent people, intent only on making money, with no desire to treat, diagnose, or, most importantly, …
I wouldn't even give one star, I don't recommend it, I brought the dog and after 2 days he came out with the same symptoms, after having paid a lot of money.
